description.value: A municipal outdoor swimming pool and spray park operated by the City of Pitt Meadows. Located along Harris Road in the Fraser Valley, it offers a refreshing stop for touring cyclists riding the flat agricultural dyke routes of Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge. The adjacent spray park adds a free cool-down option on hot days.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a municipal outdoor pool (leisure=sports_centre, sport=swimming, fee=yes) at 12460 Harris Road in Pitt Meadows. The website confirms it as 'Outdoor Public Swimming & Spray Park' operated by the City of Pitt Meadows under their Parks, Recreation & Culture department. The fetched website content is predominantly navigation menus and city notices, with no detailed facility descriptions mentioning specific amenities like bike parking, washrooms, or showers, so most amenity fields must remain null despite the likelihood a public pool would have some of these.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate municipal outdoor pool and spray park confirmed active on the City of Pitt Meadows website. A useful rest and cool-down stop for cyclists touring the flat dyke routes of the Pitt Meadows area.
